text:
We are setting up a rocket launcher off a Hughie helicopter to fire down at a crossroad. We are on top of Nui Ba Din mountain. I took the photo. 
Guessing June 1965
researchNotes: Now cataloged on VN-0006: location, date guess, and Larry as photographer. The two green berets visible in the frame corroborate the Special Forces presence he describes at the mountain camp.
